title: Code Editor Edge Row Full Path Prefetch v1
problem: After row content snapshots made replay-hit rows cheap, resize worst frames can still come from newly exposed viewport edge rows that miss the prepaint replay plan and walk the row content, rich text, geometry, and row scene path during paint.

repro.summary: Run the code editor resize probes with paint attribution enabled and confirm prepaint edge stores are present while paint no-entry/full-miss/store counters remain zero.
commands: target/release/fretboard-dev diag perf ui-code-editor-resize-probes --repeat 3 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 --sort time --top 15 --json --perf-baseline docs/workstreams/perf-baselines/ui-code-editor-resize-probes.macos-m4.v2.json --dir target/fret-diag/code-editor-edge-row-full-path-prefetch-v1-after-m3-edge-prebuild-diagnostics-split-20260515 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full

gates.name: focused-replay-plan
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-code-editor prepaint_row_scene_replay_plan --features syntax-rust --no-fail-fast

gates.name: fret-code-editor-check
gates.command: cargo check -p fret-ui -p fret-ui-kit -p fret-code-editor -p fret-diag --features syntax-rust --all-targets

gates.name: resize-perf
gates.command: target/release/fretboard-dev diag perf ui-code-editor-resize-probes --repeat 3 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 --sort time --top 15 --json --perf-baseline docs/workstreams/perf-baselines/ui-code-editor-resize-probes.macos-m4.v2.json --dir <run-dir> --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed because the edge-row paint full-path objective is complete. Start a narrow follow-on for planner-cost work, CanvasPrepaint API cleanup, renderer/display-list work, or global fret-ui layout/view-cache/VirtualList semantics if future evidence points there.
